The 'cassette' body features two spool-like structures and a rectangular shape, but it is attached to a distorted, melting strap on the left side. The bottom right corner of the object appears to be dissolving or melting into a transparent, glassy substance. There is gibberish text in the bottom left corner resembling a signature or watermark.
